name: repr-bioclim-quad
cmd: set -e; B=$(ls -d {outroot}/E039/repr-bioclim-e142ca291bf2); for c in gp_species_base desk_tempho_1995; do {python} research/exp/repr_regime.py --cache {cache}/$c --out {out}/$c --bioclim-dir $B/$c/bioclim --quadratic; done
summarize: for c in gp_species_base desk_tempho_1995; do {python} research/exp/repr_regime.py --summarize {out}/$c; done
note: E039d: bioclim with quadratic terms (+ land cover) vs desk, BLR readout, thinned data, by prevalence tier
